Eur. 6.2 (Ibuprofen). A white or almost white, crystalline powder or colourless crystals. M.p. 75° to 78°. Practically insol- uble in water; freely soluble in acetone, in dichloromethane, and in methyl alcohol; it dissolves in dilute solutions of alkali hy- droxides and carbonates. USP 31 (Ibuprofen). A white to off-white crystalline powder having a slight characteristic odour. Practically insoluble in wa- ter; very soluble in alcohol, in acetone, in chloroform, and in methyl alcohol; slightly soluble in ethyl acetate. Store in airtight containers.
